name: @citolab/pci-week-planner
description: plan tasks in a week agenda of days, time slots and resources (people, rooms, vehicles), or read, make and work out the hours and pay of a staff rota; the PCI checks the author's rules (order, days, hours, breaks, overlaps, opening hours, staffing, contract hours, rest)

scripts.prepack: npm run prod && npm run package-tao

response.$comment: The PCI evaluates the author's checks (data-planner) or the rota (data-rota): README
